official.deadline_note: MHA states 'Applications are open now till 15 March 2027!' and PSC lists the application period as 01 Sep 2026 - 15 Mar 2027. The official MHA scholarships information booklet separates the cut-offs: application form and essay by 15 March, supporting documents by 31 March, and the video presentation within 7 days of notification.
official.application_cycle: 2027 intake; PSC application period 01 Sep 2026 - 15 Mar 2027
official.status_note: The official MHA page states 'Applications are open now till 15 March 2027!' (page last updated 1 September 2026); the PSC SPF Scholarship page states 'Applications for The Singapore Police Force (SPF) Scholarship are now open'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published benefit: 'Tuition fees and other approved charges'.
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (if studying overseas)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
Full salary for the duration of your studies (including bonuses)
eligibility: Have strong leadership qualities and potential
Have a keen interest in serving in the Singapore Police Force
Have outstanding academic and Co-Curricular Activity (CCA) records
Have a GCE A-Levels, International Baccalaureate, Polytechnic, NUS High School, or other high school diploma/certificate
All MHA scholarships are open to male and female applicants
requirements: Applicants may only apply prior to pursuing their undergraduate degrees; the SPF Scholarship is not offered as a mid-term scholarship
Study at a local or overseas university in most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture
If you pursue a Law degree, you will not be called to the Bar while serving in the SPF
Courses read must be relevant to the SPF and are subject to the PSC's approval
Female applicants must submit their application earlier to have enough time to prepare for enlistment into Basic Military Training (BMT) in the Singapore Armed Forces
documents: Secondary 4 / Year 4 Year End School Academic Reports (including results and teachers' comments)
Secondary 4 / Year 4 Co-curricular Activities (CCA) and Community Involvement Programme (CIP) Records

Certificates of Academic Qualification Obtained (e.g. GCE O-level, GCE A-level, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, Polytechnic Diploma, other high school diploma or equivalent); preliminary examination results need not be included
Essay submitted together with the application form
Video presentation / video interview completed after submission
selection_criteria: Awarded to candidates who have shown outstanding leadership qualities, possess impeccable integrity and have a strong interest in policing work to safeguard the nation
Outstanding academic and Co-Curricular Activity (CCA) records; well-rounded individuals with good academic and non-academic records
Performance in psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and a psychological interview
Board interview with a panel of senior officers from various Home Team agencies
Gain entry and excel in Officer Cadet School in the SAF
Provisional offer confirmed after meeting all conditions, including medical clearance, security clearance, good NS performance (for male applicants) and university placement
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (if studying overseas)
Full salary for the duration of your studies (including bonuses)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
application_method: Apply through the Apply Now link on the MHA scholarship page, which leads to the Public Service Commission scholarship application portal (https://www.psc.gov.sg/scholarships/apply-for-scholarship/psc-scholarships/)
Log in to the PSC portal with a valid Singpass account and complete the application form; the portal is not supported on mobile devices and tablets (laptop or desktop required)
Submit the accompanying essay and upload all supporting documents; the application is only complete when the form, the essay and all documents are submitted
Complete the video interview link received within 7 days of successful submission
If shortlisted, attend psychometric assessments, game-based assessments and a psychological interview, then a board interview with the PSC Scholarships Selection Board (PSSB)
official.application_route: Apply online via the Public Service Commission scholarship portal using Singpass, reached through the Apply Now link on the official MHA scholarship page.
official.international_eligibility: No - applicants must be Singapore Citizens
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Uniformed career track with the Singapore Police Force; most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture, with courses relevant to the SPF and subject to the PSC's approval
official.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree at a local or overseas university, followed by a bond of 4 years (local studies), 5 years (studies in non-English speaking countries) or 6 years (studies in English speaking countries, including Australia, Canada and New Zealand), starting from the day the scholar assumes official duty after completing studies
official.description: Offered by the Public Service Commission and the Singapore Police Force, the SPF Scholarship is described by MHA as 'one of the most prestigious scholarships awarded by the Public Service Commission' and provides full sponsorship of undergraduate studies locally or overseas for a uniformed Home Team career.

verification.notes: Benefits, eligibility, bond and the 15 March 2027 deadline were verified directly on the official MHA scholarship page and MHA Scholarships overview; required documents, the pre-university-only application rule and the application steps were verified on the official PSC SPF Scholarship page and the PSC application process page, with the document cut-offs cross-checked in the official MHA scholarships information booklet. No monetary amount (allowance or salary figure) is published on any official page, so the amount fields remain null.

applicant_utility.summary: Treat this as a paid career track rather than a cash prize: you draw a full salary with bonuses while SPF covers tuition, a monthly maintenance allowance including accommodation and overseas airfare, then serve a bond of four to six years whose length depends on where you study. Applications for the 2027 intake run from 1 September 2026 to 15 March 2027 and are submitted through the PSC portal with Singpass, together with an essay and a video interview completed within seven days of submitting. Expect psychometric testing and a board interview with senior Home Team officers before a provisional offer around June-July, conditional on medical and security clearance, good NS performance for male applicants, and a confirmed university placement. Choose the degree carefully: medicine, dentistry and architecture are excluded, a law degree means you will not be called to the Bar while serving, and there is no mid-term route - you must apply before starting university.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with top-tier academic and CCA records who already want a uniformed policing career and can commit to a 4-6 year bond.
application_readiness_checklist: Scan all Sec 4/Year 4 year-end reports (with teachers' comments) and your full CCA and CIP record from Sec 4 through pre-tertiary into one folder before starting the portal form
Have your Singpass credentials ready and open the PSC portal on a laptop or desktop - it is not supported on mobile or tablet
Draft the essay early around genuine motivations for policing and leadership evidence, and get it reviewed against current Home Team issues
Track your university applications and outcomes, since the form asks for them and placement is a condition of the final offer
Diary both cut-offs: application form and essay by 15 March 2027, supporting documents by 31 March 2027
Male applicants: secure NS performance records early, as good NS performance is a confirmation condition
Female applicants: submit well before 15 March 2027 to leave room for BMT enlistment preparation
common_rejection_risks: Applying while already at university - the SPF Scholarship is only for pre-university applicants and is not offered as a mid-term scholarship
Weak or purely academic profile - the panel looks for demonstrated leadership and CCA impact, not just grades
Generic essay that shows no real interest in policing or awareness of current Home Team issues
Incomplete submissions - the application only counts once form, essay and every document are uploaded, and documents close later than the form
Missing the video interview window after submission or failing to complete every assessment stage, as only candidates completing all assessments reach the board interview
Failing medical or security clearance, or not meeting NS performance expectations for male applicants
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Official pages publish no monetary figures, so exact out-of-pocket costs cannot be confirmed; the maintenance allowance covers accommodation and a pre-studies allowance covers settling in, warm clothing and a computer, so expect to fund personal extras yourself
document_audit: Do not upload preliminary examination results - PSC explicitly asks only for final qualification certificates
CCA/CIP records are needed for both Secondary 4/Year 4 and the pre-tertiary phase; missing either set stalls the upload step
The portal is unusable on phones and tablets, so do not leave the submission to the last night on a mobile device
The essay is submitted through the portal as part of the application, not sent separately by email
Mid-term documents (university transcripts, employment or internship testimonials) do not apply here and will not offset a missing school-level record
alerts: Hard deadline of 15 March 2027 for the current round, with outcomes only communicated by June
This is a pre-university award only - there is no mid-term application route for the SPF Scholarship
Female applicants must apply earlier to allow time for BMT enlistment preparation
The bond runs 4, 5 or 6 years depending on whether you study locally, in a non-English speaking country, or in an English speaking country
Medicine, dentistry and architecture are excluded, and law graduates are not called to the Bar while serving in the SPF
Scholars are rotated through regular postings in their first 6 years and must excel in Officer Cadet School
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the PSC portal with Singpass, fill the form plus essay and upload documents, complete the video interview link within 7 days, then await shortlisting for psychometric and board interviews with results by June.
